note.zh: 非地下帝国继续深挖：矿石洞穴与超富矿修正，链结束。
note.en: Non-subterranean empires dig on: ore caverns and the ultra-rich modifier; the chain ends.

note.zh: 海妖尸体成为矿藏，解除清洗状态，获得凝聚力。
note.en: Its body becomes a deposit, the purge ends and unity is granted.

notes.zh: 审阅注：“肯定还有更多”有两个同名选项：非地下帝国（且非宇宙黎明起源）→ 为“石”过早；地下帝国或宇宙黎明 → 更多矿物。每次深挖都要花能量（1000/1500/2000/2500）。
notes.en: Review note: "There has to be more" exists twice: non-subterranean empires (not Cosmic Dawn) get Too Little, Too Deep; subterranean or Cosmic Dawn get More Ore. Each deeper probe costs energy (1000/1500/2000/2500).

notes.zh: 审阅注：海妖陆军出现后：若被地面部队击败 → 9081；若以其他方式被消灭（隐藏9082）星球得到“被轰炸的海妖尸体”矿藏；若海妖占领星球（隐藏9095），人口被杀至只剩少量并获得海妖修正。
notes.en: Review note: once the kraken army spawns — killed in ground combat → 9081; destroyed otherwise (hidden 9082) → a bombed-kraken deposit; if it occupies the planet (hidden 9095) pops are killed down to a remnant and the planet gets the kraken modifier.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选择“安全第一”移除水晶矿藏与超富矿修正，链结束。
notes.en: Review note: "Safety first" removes the crystal deposit and ultra-rich modifier and ends the chain.

scope.zh: “贪婪之害”全部事件（9050–9095，含三个隐藏回调）；原独立故事 event-colony-9080（海妖被击败）已并入。
scope.en: All 'Greed is Bad' events (9050–9095 incl. three hidden callbacks); the former story event-colony-9080 (kraken defeated) is merged here.
